bugs.summary: When a continued (multi-line) string token ends inside f-string braces, the state is STATE_IN_BRACES, not STATE_NOT_FSTRING. The check `current() == STATE_NOT_FSTRING` is false there, so an ordinary string is sent down the f-string branch. It is split as an f-string middle, which corrupts the tokenization and the parse.
bugs.trigger: A multi-line (continued) string inside f-string braces, e.g. f"{'''a\nb'''}": it is tokenized as an f-string middle and formatting fails (fix #4339 also accepts STATE_IN_BRACES).
